wf(task): submit task-003-rfc-6902-conformance-of-applypatch-validation-and-errors

Carries content: the body

WingFoil-Version: 0.3.1 (unknown)

Validate JSON Patch before applying, and require JSON values

applyPatch checked each operation only when it was reached, so an
invalid operation after a failing one was reported as an operation
failure (Error) rather than an invalid patch (SyntaxError). Values were
also accepted when they are not JSON (undefined, NaN, Date, functions,
cycles), and operation members were read through the prototype chain.

The whole patch is now parsed before any operation runs. add, replace
and test require a JSON value. Operation members are read as own
properties. Tests and README state the checks and error types.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
